class.name: inverted_pendulum_rl_controller/InvertedPendulumRlController
class.description: DDPG reinforcement-learning balance controller for the Inverted pendulum. Trains online in simulation (mock_pendulum_hardware) and, once enable_training is set false with a trained actor checkpoint loaded, runs actor-only inference against real hardware exposed through ZenbeddedHardware (zenoh transport to the Zephyr firmware).
